entities.summary: Robert Lowery Jr. is an American professional basketball player for Al-Najma of the Bahraini Premier League. Standing at 1.88 m, he plays the point guard position. After two years at Cecil College and two years at Dayton, Lowery entered the 2010 NBA draft but was not selected in the draft's two rounds.
